answer: Each epoch, every agent key must solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle that needs about 2 GB of RAM held for ten minutes, and the seed only appears at the epoch zenith, so nobody can precompute it. One honest agent barely notices the cost. A farm of a thousand keys has to rent a thousand machines all at once, and that rented hardware is as rare as jade on a frozen tundra. Keys that miss the puzzle earn nothing that epoch, so the attacker pays more for hardware than the farm earns back.
